title: Check ACB System Statistics (robot faults, system faults, cycle time, tipping station bag counts) on the ACB System Statistics screen
summary: Open the OptiSweep Tipper HMI/WebVisu “ACB System” screen, press “STATISTICS” to view the “ACB System Statistics” screen, and verify the displayed ACB metrics: number of robot faults, number of system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.
when_to_use: Use when you need a quick, on-screen view of current Automated Carton Buffer (ACB) statistics—robot faults, system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts—on the live OptiSweep HMI.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the “ACB System Statistics” screen and confirm the four ACB metrics are present and populated with numeric/statistical values.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access to view the ACB System screens

visual_references.description: Figure 4-5: ACB System Statistics Screen layout showing the statistical information areas for robot faults, system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.

steps.title: Open ACB System Statistics from the ACB System screen
steps.purpose: Access the live ACB System Statistics screen that contains the required ACB metrics.
steps.instruction: On the Tipper HMI/WebVisu/VISU, open the “ACB System” screen, then press the “STATISTICS” button to access the “ACB System Statistics” screen.
steps.expected_result: The “ACB System Statistics” screen opens successfully.
steps.healthy_condition: The “ACB System Statistics” screen is displayed (not an error page or blank/unresponsive screen).
steps.failure_condition: Pressing “STATISTICS” does not open the “ACB System Statistics” screen.

actions.label: Press STATISTICS
actions.exact_action: Press STATISTICS on the "ACB System" screen to access this screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: STATISTICS button does not open the ACB System Statistics screen

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press STATISTICS on the "ACB System" screen to access this screen. This screen provides a variety of statistical information, including the number of robot faults, system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.

steps.title: Locate and record the four ACB metrics on the ACB System Statistics screen
steps.purpose: Capture the current values shown for the required ACB statistics.
steps.instruction: On the “ACB System Statistics” screen, locate the displayed values for: (1) number of robot faults, (2) number of system faults, (3) cycle time, and (4) tipping station bag counts.
steps.expected_result: All four metric areas are visible and you can read the displayed values for robot faults, system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.
steps.healthy_condition: Each of the four metrics is present on the screen with a readable numeric/statistical value.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the four metrics are missing/blank when the screen is open.

actions.label: Read metric values
actions.exact_action: Locate and record the displayed values for: number of robot faults, number of system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.

stop_or_escalate_if: One or more of the four metrics (robot faults, system faults, cycle time, tipping station bag counts) are missing/blank

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: This screen provides a variety of statistical information, including the number of robot faults, system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.

steps.title: Confirm the ACB System Statistics screen is populated with numeric/statistical values
steps.purpose: Ensure the screen is providing current statistical data rather than blank/missing fields.
steps.instruction: Verify that the “ACB System Statistics” screen shows numeric/statistical values (not blank/missing) for all four metrics: robot faults, system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.
steps.expected_result: The four metrics are populated with numeric/statistical values.
steps.healthy_condition: No metric field is blank/missing; all four values are displayed.
steps.failure_condition: Any of the four metrics are blank/missing.

actions.label: Check for blanks
actions.exact_action: Confirm the screen is populated with numeric/statistical values (not blank/missing) for the four metrics.

stop_or_escalate_if: One or more of the four metrics are missing/blank when the screen is open

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: This screen provides a variety of statistical information, including the number of robot faults, system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.

success_criteria: The “ACB System Statistics” screen opens after pressing “STATISTICS” on the “ACB System” screen.
The screen displays all four required metrics: number of robot faults, number of system faults, cycle time, and tipping station bag counts.
None of the four metrics are blank/missing.
healthy_conditions: All four ACB metrics are visible and populated with numeric/statistical values on the “ACB System Statistics” screen.
failure_conditions: The “STATISTICS” button does not open the “ACB System Statistics” screen.
One or more of the four metrics (robot faults, system faults, cycle time, tipping station bag counts) are missing/blank.
escalation_guidance: If the “STATISTICS” button does not open the “ACB System Statistics” screen, stop and escalate to support.
If one or more of the four metrics are missing/blank when the screen is open, stop and escalate to support.
